messages:
julia.kim: Noticed multiple SCIM deprovisions after last night's RBAC prune. Provisioner logs show KMS decrypt failures and some SAML audience mismatches. Can we triage?

omar: paste a few log lines and one sanitized assertion?

julia.kim: Logs:
```
2026-03-01T03:22:10Z provisioner ERROR decrypt externalId uid=anne@example.com error=KMS::NotFound key=alias/service-scim-v2
2026-03-01T03:22:11Z provisioner WARN deprovision queued uid=anne@example.com reason=attr_missing
2026-03-01T03:22:12Z scim PATCH /Users/anne@example.com {"active":false}
```
Assertion (sanitized): `<Assertion><Subject>anne@example.com</Subject><Audience>https://login.redwood-infer.example.com/sso</Audience></Assertion>`

lee.s: We did a KMS alias rotate yesterday (alias/service-scim -> alias/service-scim-v2) and also changed prod hostnames behind the SSO load balancer. Sounds related.

omar: Quick checks: 1) in the provisioner pod, `env | grep KMS_ALIAS` 2) `aws kms list-aliases` from the IAM role 3) curl SP metadata to confirm EntityID.

julia.kim: running checks now. Also paused the RBAC prune cronjob to stop further churn.

infra-bot: [ALERT] 2026-03-01T03:25:00Z - 5 deprovision events detected; creating incident INC-2026-1502.

lee.s: If alias was renamed and old alias deleted, decrypt calls will 404. We should either recreate alias with previous key or update the app env var to the v2 alias and restart canary.

omar: For SAML audience: our nginx rewrite was stripping the subdomain. Ask infra to preserve Host header or update SP EntityID.

julia.kim: update: KMS_ALIAS env still pointed at alias/service-scim (deleted). Repointing to alias/service-scim-v2 and restarting a canary pod fixed decrypt for the sample user. Also adjusted nginx to not rewrite host for SSO path.

lee.s: Good. Follow-ups: 1) add a provisioner guard to avoid auto-deprovision on transient decrypt errors 2) update KMS alias rotation runbook (approve cutover + app env update) 3) postmortem for RBAC prune timing.

omar: I'll open RFC for the guard and update the runbook. Re-enable RBAC prune after 30m of stability.

julia.kim: thanks — monitoring for churn. :eyes:
summary: Incident where SCIM deprovisioning was triggered by concurrent KMS alias rotation and SAML audience change; immediate fix was env update + nginx host fix; follow-ups scheduled.
